note.title: Energy balance, deficiency and BMI
note.overview: Body mass tends to remain stable when energy intake equals energy use. BMI is mass divided by height squared and is a screening calculation, not a diagnosis.
learningGoals: Recall the precise Year 8 vocabulary for energy balance, deficiency and bmi.
Apply the knowledge rather than relying on recognition alone.
Use the command word and include every required scientific point.
mustMemoriseRules: BMI = body mass (kg) / height squared (m squared).
Vitamin A deficiency can cause night blindness; vitamin D deficiency can cause rickets; vitamin C deficiency can cause scurvy.
Energy needs vary with growth, body size, activity, pregnancy and metabolic rate.
